address: 16 Eylül, 3047. Sokak No:7/A, Çeşme, Izmir, 35930, Türkiye
bio: This family-run Turkish osteria is tucked away in one of Çeşme's charming side streets, making it the perfect stop after a day of shopping or relaxing on the beach. Super-fresh fish and seafood is served straight off the boat at lunchtime, in simple dishes that showcase the natural flavours of the produce in all their glory. Start with mezze such as artichoke hearts with spring onions and crushed raspberries, then move on to prawns grilled to that perfect point of translucency, with an exquisite jus just begging to be mopped up with every last piece of bread – no unnecessary frills, just the briny richness of coastal cuisine with Mediterranean flair.
